designDecisions: Tidal drive expresses as AMPLITUDE of the coarse octaves, not as base FREQUENCY. The eight-body calibration table survives and is read more carefully; Io's rows record features ON Io, i.e. an absence of large-scale relief.
Every non-gas body keeps a characteristic length of order one body radius, which is what restores LOD headroom.

The amplitude term ships as a driver on the rockySurface pack so both front-ends receive it through writePackUniforms by construction — Max's 'period' is satisfied structurally, and AC-3 gates it by measurement anyway.
The extrapolation bound MAX_FINER_THAN_IO added on 2026-08-26 is superseded by this change, not reverted separately.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Spine conformance (Rule 15). The new amplitude driver is D-slot-backed — it derives from the SAME rawTidalIoRatio / tidalHeat the retired frequency term read (conditionVector.js:154, baseStep.js:29), has a NAMED consumer in the shader, and is registered in the pack taxonomy. No frozen constant stands in for a driver.
macroWavelengthKm returns K_MACRO_R * R for EVERY non-gas body: lambda/R is 1.16 with zero spread across the 1160-body corpus. macroShortening is gone as a frequency term.

LOD HEADROOM RESTORED AND MEASURED. Usable octaves between 'spans the disc' and 'starts to alias' at 4 body radii is >= 5 for every non-gas body, against 1 today and 0 before the bound. Reproduced by tools/lod-chain-probe.mjs at the game pixel budget.

⭐⭐ MAX'S CONSTRAINT, AS A GATE: for every body in the corpus, the uniform values the LAB writes and the values the GAME writes are IDENTICAL for the new amplitude driver and for uNoiseScale — not merely both present, bit-equal. A probe compares the two front-ends' written uniforms body-by-body and fails on any divergence. ⛔ This AC exists because the lab diverged from the game by 3-7x for months without anyone noticing, and Max said 'period'. EXECUTION NOTE: the value-equality arm is structurally vacuous once both front-ends pass the same display radius. The arm that can actually fail is the sabotage one — resolve the driver at an absurd display radius and assert it does not move — which is the exact failure mode uNoiseScale had.

AMENDED 2026-08-26 during execution — the original statement named the wrong property. The DISTANCE budget is binding FAR (>= ~6 body radii, where it must suppress early detail) and the fwidth fade is binding NEAR (< ~4 radii, where its only job is anti-aliasing). Neither mechanism is asked to do the other's job. Measured live: octaves 1 / 1 / 2.81 / 6.36 / 8.87 / 9 at 12 / 8 / 6 / 4 / 2 / 1.3 radii.
uFwClamp is only an anti-aliasing floor again: no octave that clears the Nyquist bar is removed by it inside 8 radii. The [K] legibility arm still exists and still flips, as a safety net.
A tidally-active body is FLATTER at large scales and no rougher at small ones than an equivalent cold body — measured as relief amplitude per octave band, not asserted from the look.
The change is on a bare key in world-engine-lab.html with the arm printed on the badge, so it can be judged in motion per feedback_showcase-by-parking-the-live-game.

Instrument A/B/C readings named and unchanged except where this workstream declares a move: citations resolve, the uniform-inventory ratchets pass or are re-blessed WITH a named justification in the commit, and port-uniform-delta reports the new driver as a declared addition rather than drift.
